posts.title: Two Short Writings
posts.description: Process I grab a big dictionary and some extra thick paper. In an extra wet pen I write down each word that sticks to my skull. I then chew the paper at a time that I choose. Then I swallow the paper. Then I sleep on any couch for no more than three hours and no less than one. At some point a bird flies through a window and probably spits in my mouth.
